bestBets.overview: Rain on Saturday and Sunday should push the Casterton track into the heavy range for the day. Difficult to assess this race but ZOOM can improve on a promising hurdle debut in a strong maiden hurdle here last month. THURMOND will have blinkers first time in his jumps debut but he showed ability in his Coleraine hurdle trial win. PALENTINO HEIGHTS has had a few tries over jumps this season but might find this a bit easier than recent runs. FLYING WITNESS was OK in a stronger hurdle race at Coleraine and has trialed well since.

raceTips.comment: Early favourites Lodbrok and Shogun Express have jumped poorly this season and not convinced they should be sitting at the top of the betting. Flying Witness might be the value play in a wide open contest and the booking of leading rider Will Gordon is encouraging. She was highly competitive against Split, Flashlight and Ferago at Coleraine last start and now looks well placed coming back to maiden grade. Zoom had the better of key rivals when third to Flashlight last start and should be shorter in betting than those she comfortably defeated at Casterton. Thurmond is making his jumps debut and looked solid in a recent hurdle trial win.

He had a nice tick over run on the flat during the week and will be hard to run down if he gets his own way in front. Charlie Messy Hair was a surprise winner of a BM115 steeple at this track and distance on July 5. He jumped well and was too good for more fancied stablemate Saint Eustace on that occasion. That form is solid for this contest. Christmas jumped well when second to Ongatiti at Hamilton and is still improving.

AMBELLO found it tough in a harder race at Murtoa last time out but has a good record on this track with a good gate here. SYMPHONITE hit the line well at Mt Gambier last start and could be strong late if the tempo is quicker than predicted.

raceTips.comment: Flat races at Casterton are generally dominated by leaders/horses who can settle rails in run. While Symphonite is unlikely to lead, drawing barrier one could provide her with the run of the race behind the expected leader Hughie. She has been consistent without winning in harder races this campaign and deserves to be favourite. Hughie is coming back to a more suitable class and will be tough to run down. Ambello was a dominant winner at this track first-up but has struggled to replicate that performance in three subsequent starts.

bestBets.overview: The biggest field of the day here but there looks to be a distinct lack of early speed. That scenario would perfectly set up the race for THE CABLE GUY to break through from barrier five after two solid efforts to start his career. WAR NO MORE has a tricky gate but could push forward again to find an on-pace position with the lack of early speed. FIOROWNGOOD struggled over a longer trip at Warrnambool but placed in this distance range first-up. HILL CRY can improve on his first-up outing over this longer trip.

raceTips.comment: The Cable Guy has a golden opportunity to win a maiden dropping back to highweight grade. His debut effort behind Oyster Lane is by far the best form of any runner in this field, with three subsequent maiden winners coming from that race. He then stuck on well in a fast-run race on very heavy ground at Bendigo last start, so the conditions at Casterton should be no issue. Fiorowngood didn't fire at Warrnambool but showed with his previous run at Geelong that he is capable of winning in this grade. War No More might be the value play at double figures as he is expected to lead.

bestBets.overview: Expecting an even speed in this, which should suit EIRE TO THE JUNGLE after his steady second-up effort behind a mare that has won at Flemington since while he is also a heavy track winner. MR CHARISMATIC was only fair in a slightly harder race on the synthetic last time out but might be looking for this longer trip now. STATE OF MAINE led and gave a good sight in tough conditions at Hamilton and has placed twice on this circuit. DARK HARMONY found boggy conditions too wet at Hamilton but has won three over 1400m.
bestBets.suggestedBet: Eire To The Jungle to win.

raceTips.comment: Eire To The Jungle can improve dropping back to restricted 56 class. His latest two starts have been in much stronger races and the inside draw looks beneficial. Should settle near the lead and prove tough to run down. State Of Maine was okay on her home track last Saturday and also should be positioned near the lead, which is generally the place to be at Casterton. Mr Charismatic's best form would win this race, he is just awfully hard to catch and is very inconsistent.

bestBets.overview: Possibly the hardest race of the day to finish the Casterton meeting with the forecast rain to make the track conditions difficult by then. HIGH CLASS ROLLER will be much fitter for a sound first-up outing at Hamilton while he has a good second-up record. DIGARI was outsprinted in soft conditions at Murtoa and could find this a slightly easier assignment. SMOKIN' ROHIE got a long way back over 2400m at Swan Hill and could improve dropping in trip. FLYING SHELBY gets back up to the 2000m for the first time in more than a year and is racing like he's looking for the distance now.

raceTips.comment: Digari should now be at peak fitness and looks well placed rising in distance. His form last preparation at staying distances was against much stronger opposition than he faces in this race. Smokin' Rohie held his own in a handy race at Swan Hill last start and can improve returning to highweight class. He defeated key rivals when second to Sadlers Symphony at Coleraine and maps to get a soft run from the inside draw. Octahedron won well at Hamilton last week and his ability to settle near the lead could be beneficial in this race.
